newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk treasury offers banks foreign currency bonds.
newsitem.headline: Turk treasury offers banks foreign currency bonds.

text.p: Turkey's treasury has sent letters to Turkish banks, offering them foreign currency denominated bonds, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the treasury asked banks to reply to the invitation letters by Friday.
The bonds have a maturity of three years with a put option at the end of the second year. They carry an interest of Libor plus 260 basis points.
The minimum participation amount in the deal is $15 million and the maximum amount is $150 million.
